title: Delegation worktree sweeper: no test of background request coalescing, and no recovery from a panicking pass
outcome: The background delegation-worktree sweeper's coalescing (running/again) is covered by a behavioural test, and a pass that panics or a thread that fails to spawn cannot leave the sweeper stuck with running=true so that no later request ever sweeps.
acceptance: Delegation worktree sweeper: no test of background request coalescing, and no recovery from a panicking pass is done
